about: Published plays whose reading still has a fault no rule of play_roles settles (catalog DECISIONS 044): they serve as they are. Read by a person before an entry is added or removed. What a person has read and corrected is in editorial/play_corrections.json (catalog DECISIONS 046); this list is only what is left.
